arStrings.szText: Guided by the Oracle, Tharra begins mending the wounds she carries within.

Tharra has traveled ahead to the village of Sarpeda in Celestia to await my arrival. From there, we will venture out in search of the Cavern of Echoes the Oracle described.

It seems Tharra already knows something of this place.

Tharra has traveled ahead to the village of Sarpeda in Celestia to await my arrival. From there, we will venture out in search of the Cavern of Echoes the Oracle described.

It seems Tharra already knows something of this place. I should speak with her to begin.

According to Tharra, the Cavern of Echoes lies in the southern reaches of Celestia. It is a strange cave where old magics stir. She explored it as a child, and it was there she first felt called to become an Amazon.

What the Cavern will choose to unveil now is uncertain. The Oracle's guidance is never without intent.
